brief.claim: The training programme improves task accuracy more than the control activity: the mean change in accuracy (post minus pre) is larger in the trained group than in the control group, and a two-sample t test of the difference between the two groups' mean changes gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: task accuracy (proportion correct) of each subject before the programme
task accuracy (proportion correct) of each subject after the programme
whether the subject took part in the training programme (true) or in the control activity (false)

brief.sizes: subjects = 40 (pre, post and trained: 40 values each)
